notes: The player and {name} never take a gendered past tense or adjective (postavil si / postavila si): present tense, impersonal forms or nouns instead (Nájazd na tvoju dedinu: {name}).
Placeholders always stay in the nominative: after a colon or in apposition to a declined noun (budova {building}, hráča {arg1}).
Plurals use one / few / many / other as Intl.PluralRules("sk") gives them (many is for decimals).

Generated names should use noun-first (generatedNames: noun-first): second parts are capitalised nouns (Štít, Priesmyk, Údolie), first parts are lower-case genitive nouns that fit every gender (hromu, hmly, železa): Priesmyk hromu, Údolie železa. This setting is not yet in languages.json (integration step).
Slovak letters (ľ č ť š ž ď ň ŕ ĺ) are outside Latin-1, so sk needs SYSTEM_FONT_LANGS and the styles.css lang rule (integration step); tests/locales/latin-fonts.test.ts fails until then.
The Japanese statutory pages (tokushoho, shikin-kessai) are translated into Slovak; the support page links them by their Japanese titles.
ui.s_have_bced00a61e and ui.your_purchase_been_delivered_6f88dee143 are English sentence fragments not used by the current code; they were translated so that together they read "Nákupy sú dodané".
